law.citation: Wikidata states that the union territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu (Q77997266, ISO 3166-2 IN-DH) was formed on 2020-01-26, and that Daman and Diu (Q66710) was dissolved on that date.

units.citation: Wikidata, the union territory's item, read on 2026-11-28: English label, item id and ISO 3166-2 code. The GeoNames id is the territory's row in the GeoNames country file.

membership.citation: The members are the three district records of the two former union territories: Daman and Diu, whose parent was Daman and Diu, and Dadra & Nagar Haveli, whose parent was Dadra and Nagar Haveli.

units.name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
